CustomField.description:
When this field is checked, it indicates that this country is explicitly called out in the Permitted Countries Policy (PCP) document.
Link to the PCP document in Sharepoint: https://tanium.sharepoint.com/sites/EmpHub-Policy%20Central/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FEmpHub%2DPolicy%20Central%2FShared%20Documents%2FProtecting%20Tanium%20Information%20%26%20IP%2FPermitted%20Countries%20Policy%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FEmpHub%2DPolicy%20Central%2FShared%20Documents%2FProtecting%20Tanium%20Information%20%26%20IP
